form:FormGroup.label: Value Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The largest whole-number value a single data point can hold, from Max 255 (1 byte) to about 9.2 quintillion (8 bytes). Larger limits need more storage. Default is Max 65,535.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Largest whole number per data point; larger limits need more storage.

form:FormGroup.label: Store Latest Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stores the most recent value received in each time period. Default is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Most recent value in each period. Default is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Store Min Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stores the smallest value received in each time period. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Smallest value in each period. Default is unticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Store Max Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stores the largest value received in each time period. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Largest value in each period. Default is unticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Store Count
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stores how many values were received in each time period. Needed, with Store Sum, to calculate averages. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Needed with Store Sum to calculate averages.

form:FormGroup.label: Store Sum
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stores the total of the values received in each time period. Needed, with Store Count, to calculate averages. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Needed with Store Count to calculate averages.
